Tongue-tied back Home — Cultural Project

Idiom postcard series connecting scattered Slovaks abroad.

tap postcard to flip

Pohľadnica is Slovak for postcard, literally translating to a “glance-lette”, a tiny look into someone’s life from somewhere else.
Living in Rotterdam, I noticed how scattered Slovaks are.
There is no real community, only a language we happen to share.

So, I built something out of that language and created an opportunity for connection.
Slovak idioms only resonate with those who grew up with them. Together with a local (fully) Slovak crew, I brought five of them to life.

For now, it’s the four of us, but the vision is to expand this into a dictionary-style box:
The Literal Slovak Idiom Dictionary.

But there is another way to connect online with Slovaks
across NLthe Netherlands: Stamp Me.
